exposure: cases: preterm delivery before 34 weeks with preeclampsia
preterm delivery before 34 weeks with preeclampsia (cases) vs. preterm delivery before 34 weeks without preeclampsia (controls)
controls: preterm delivery before 34 weeks without preeclampsia
cohort: 204 women aged 20-40 years; 98 with preterm delivery before 34 weeks due to preeclampsia or placental insufficiency (cases) and 106 with preterm delivery before 34 weeks without preeclampsia (controls)
finding: Women with preterm delivery before 34 weeks due to preeclampsia or placental insufficiency had a significantly higher prevalence of APLA (17.3% vs. 3.8%, p=0.001).
